change: Grouped and ungrouped Parquet task checkpoint construction share a single scan loop driven by generic physical reduction operators. Both use owned mutable accumulators and owned checkpoint snapshots. Grouped tasks expose aggregateParquetGroupTaskOwned; plain callers transfer results at return. Partition-column augmentation now runs consistently in the shared loop.

realFixture: null and string group keys across multiple row groups
Hive-style partition key included with group values
sum/count snapshots match explicit expected groups
checkpoint stays charged after task return until release
maxGroups rejection preserves LAKEQL_GROUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and releases reservations

remaining: Grouped multi-task fan-in still calls plain checkpoints and legacy merge/finalization functions.
Grouped order/limit shaping and batch construction need owned output integration.
Partition vector construction, predicate scratch, metadata and topology admission still need review.
